coverage_caveat: The cutoff has coverage one. Frozen Combined retains its original abstentions and MLP fallback; full-set regret agreement does not imply equal coverage.

existing_sensitivities.scope: Full frozen portfolio only; descriptive alternative fallback and dataset omissions. No preprocessing results or independently retrained records are inserted.

full_portfolio_confusion.interpretation: Observed action/outcome counts in the full frozen portfolio only; a margin-based correct target can still incur a positive raw regret.
full_portfolio_confusion.regret_definition: max(graph_test, mlp_test) minus effective selected test accuracy; no margin
full_portfolio_confusion.target_definition: graph iff graph_test - mlp_test > 0.01; otherwise mlp

headroom_closure_definition: (always_graph_regret - policy_regret) / always_graph_regret; negative means worse; null when headroom is zero.
headroom_definition: Always-graph raw regret; maximum achievable reduction to the same unit oracle.
oracle_definition: Per unit max(MLP test accuracy, validation-selected graph test accuracy) within the evaluated portfolio; recomputed separately for each portfolio.
scope: Full six-architecture portfolio and every single-architecture restriction; no new training, model selection trials, or test evaluations.

source_verification.manifest_trust: The manifest is a trust input, not a signature; obtain it from the verified release or review package.
source_verification.verification: Release manifest file hashes and complete record scope; frozen assembly/trial/config/split/provenance checks; reconstructed complete audit matched; duplicate JSON keys rejected.

test_oracle_caveat: Minimum regret is selected using all retained test outcomes. It is an optimistic in-sample bound only for this one-sided cutoff family, not a held-out or prospective estimate, not a new method, and not LODO calibration.
threshold_rule: graph iff h1 >= t, otherwise mlp; t in [0,1], full coverage and no abstention
threshold_search: Exact constant-action intervals using every observed h1 boundary; evaluate closed upper endpoints, including zero/one boundaries; no grid.
validation_selection: Reuse the frozen evaluator: choose graph only if validation gap exceeds 0.01.
weighting: Equal dataset weights and equal seed weights within each dataset; frozen scope is 11 x 10.
